about: A bench world for romance and slower drama: attraction, guarded hearts, family loyalty and quiet scenes that must not stall. Invented, with no explicit content: the world sets up a slow-burning attraction and leaves how far it goes to play. It brings about Checks on persuasion and risky moves, a Plot Thread that resolves within a few days (the sale at the end of the harvest), secrets for NPCs to learn, Loose Ends, lore to grow, a wildfire, and people who may die. actions holds the fixed words of the Rewrite, Edit and World Change the bench sends.

save.title: The Last Harvest at Corra
save.artStyle: Luminous Fluid Watercolor: Soft semi-translucent aesthetic characterized by delicate watery washes, soft-edge color bleeding, visible paper grain texture, expressive paint splatters, and vibrant pigment pooling along fine hand-drawn ink contours.
save.worldBrief: The Corra estate, an old family vineyard on the dry hills above a sea town in a sunny southern country of the present day, with stone farmhouses, olive terraces and a small frescoed chapel. It is the last week of the grape harvest, the hot wind has dried the hills to tinder, and everyone on the estate is keeping something from someone.
save.startingHook: Mara Quell, an art restorer, has arrived at the Corra estate to save the crumbling fresco in its chapel before the harvest ends. Anselm Corra, the widowed winemaker who hired her, meets her at the gate and is cooler than his letters were. His grandmother, Ilse Corra, insists Mara stay in the main house, and Bette Sorell, who runs the estate, shows her to her room without a smile.

pc.name: Mara Quell
pc.background: A restorer of wall paintings from the capital, freelance since she walked out of a museum job and a long engagement in the same month two years ago. She took this commission because it pays well and is far from everyone she knows.
pc.physicalTraits: A slight woman in her early thirties with olive skin, dark curly hair usually tied up, brown eyes, paint and plaster always under her nails, and a small tattoo of a swallow on her wrist.
pc.skills: Restoring frescoes and old plaster, reading old inscriptions, chemistry of pigments, climbing scaffolds, noticing what people do with their hands.
pc.personality: Warm, funny and impulsive, quick to care and quicker to leave before she can be hurt. Honest to a fault once she trusts someone.

importantCharacters.name: Anselm Corra
importantCharacters.description: A tall man of about forty with a lean weathered face, close-cut greying dark hair, a short beard, grey-green eyes, rolled shirtsleeves and work trousers stained with grape must. The winemaker, guarded, gentle with the vines and short with people.

importantCharacters.name: Ilse Corra
importantCharacters.description: A tiny woman of eighty-five with white hair in a neat bun, bright black eyes, a black dress, a cardigan in all weathers and a walking stick of olive wood. Anselm's grandmother, sharp-tongued and matchmaking.

importantCharacters.name: Bette Sorell
importantCharacters.description: A striking woman in her late thirties with sun-streaked blonde hair in a plait, a strong jaw, a linen work shirt, jeans and boots, a clipboard always in hand. The estate manager, efficient and cold to strangers.

carrying: restoration kit in a canvas roll

worldRules: There is no magic; the dangers are fire, heat, the steep terraces, the sea and people's hearts.
The harvest ends with the feast on Saturday night, when the estate's year is settled.
Phones have little signal on the hills; the house has a landline and the town is twenty minutes down a winding road.
The fire brigade warns that one spark on these hills in this wind can burn a valley in an hour.
plotThreads: Anselm has secretly agreed to sell the estate to Victor Haldane, a hotel developer, to pay the debts his late wife Chiara left; he signs on Saturday after the harvest feast, has told no one but Bette, and means to let his grandmother learn it only once it is done.

Bette Sorell still loves Anselm, whom she was to marry before he met Chiara, and is quietly ruining the fresco work, wetting the plaster at night, so the restorer fails and leaves; she fears what Anselm feels around Mara, and she knows about the sale.

Ilse Corra's heart is failing and she has told only the town doctor; she means to live to see one last harvest, and she knows an old family story that the chapel fresco hides the deed that forbids the estate ever being sold, but not where.

worldBible.title: The Corra estate
worldBible.content: Eighty acres of old vines and olive terraces on steep dry hills above the sea, with a big stone farmhouse, a cellar dug into the hill, workers' cottages and a small chapel on a rise among cypresses. The family has made wine here for three hundred years. Pickers come up from the town each harvest.

worldBible.title: Anselm Corra
worldBible.content: A tall man of about forty with a lean weathered face, close-cut greying dark hair, a short beard, grey-green eyes, rolled shirtsleeves and work trousers stained with grape must. Widowed two years ago when his wife Chiara died in a car crash on the coast road; he found out after that she had borrowed heavily against the estate. Proud, private and lonely, he has not let anyone close since, and he is ashamed of the sale he has agreed to.

worldBible.title: Ilse Corra
worldBible.content: A tiny woman of eighty-five with white hair in a neat bun, bright black eyes, a black dress, a cardigan in all weathers and a walking stick of olive wood. She raised Anselm. Her heart is failing and she hides her pills. She wants Anselm happy before she dies, likes Mara on sight, and dislikes Bette for reasons she won't say.

worldBible.title: Bette Sorell
worldBible.content: A striking woman in her late thirties with sun-streaked blonde hair in a plait, a strong jaw, a linen work shirt, jeans and boots, a clipboard always in hand. She grew up on the estate, the foreman's daughter, and was to marry Anselm before he met Chiara. She runs the estate brilliantly and has nowhere else to go. She would lie, but never let the vines or the people come to harm.

worldBible.title: Victor Haldane
worldBible.content: A smooth, tanned developer in his fifties in pale linen suits, who builds luxury hotels on the coast. He wants the hill for its view and means to tear out the vines. He arrives for the feast on Saturday with the papers.

worldBible.title: The chapel fresco
worldBible.content: A fresco of the harvest with saints and the family's founders, painted in 1720 across the chapel's east wall, flaking from damp. Under the painted vine at the lower right, a later layer of plaster hides a painted inscription: the founder's deed binding the land to the family forever, which a court would honour. Wet plaster speeds the flaking.

worldBible.title: The hot wind
worldBible.content: A hot dry wind off the inland plain blows in the last weeks of summer. The scrub on the hills above the estate has not had rain since spring. A fire there would race down to the vines and the house within the hour.

worldBible.title: The harvest feast
worldBible.content: On the last night of the harvest the family feeds every picker at long tables under the pergola, with music and the year's first wine. It is when the estate settles its debts and makes its announcements.

worldBible.title: Dr Paolo Ferri
worldBible.content: The town's old doctor, a kind tired man who has treated the Corras for forty years. He knows Ilse's heart is failing and has begged her to rest; he will not break her confidence unless she is in danger.

actions.rewrite: Slow down, and let the people present react to what just happened before anything new happens.
actions.edit: Above the terraces, a thin thread of smoke was rising from the scrub.
actions.worldChange: Victor Haldane has arrived two days early and is staying at the house as Anselm's guest.
